source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text:
Ongoing soil and fertilizer management (ការគ្រប់គ្រងជីជាតិដី) includes periodic soil testing where possible, regular weeding to reduce competition for water and nutrients, mulching to conserve soil moisture and moderate soil temperature, pruning to maintain good tree structure, and a fertilizing schedule combining organic compost with chemical fertilizer (NPK 15-15-15 together with urea, following the same general approach as other MAFF citrus guides in this knowledge base).

The guide frames these practices explicitly as climate-resilience measures: mulching and organic matter improve the soil's ability to hold moisture during dry spells and drain excess water during heavy rain, which reduces the orchard's vulnerability to both drought stress and waterlogging as rainfall becomes less predictable.
